components.name: Aurora
components.summary: The slow-drifting violet, sky and rose light behind every Brolly page.

components.name: Glass
components.summary: The frosted-glass surface that everything sits on: translucent fill, backdrop blur, a hairline edge and a soft glow.

components.name: Button
components.summary: The gradient-pill primary button and its quieter siblings, with a magnetic lean and a springy press.

components.name: HoldButton
components.summary: A press-and-hold button that fills as you hold and only fires when it completes, for anything destructive.

components.name: Field
components.summary: Floating-label text inputs, textareas, selects and search fields with inline validation.

components.name: DateField
components.summary: A date field that understands plain words, day-first, and shows how it understood you before you commit.

components.name: Controls
components.summary: Switches, checkboxes, radios and sliders with glass-bead handles that spring when toggled.

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: A pill tab bar with a gliding glass thumb that springs to the selected tab.

components.name: Gem
components.summary: A small faceted chip for status, tags and counts, with a tone and an optional icon.

components.name: Keycap
components.summary: The little keyboard-key glyphs used to teach shortcuts.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: Dry-wit tooltips that give a title, one wry line and the shortcut.

components.name: Rail
components.summary: The collapsible left navigation rail that expands on hover and can be pinned.

components.name: CommandBar
components.summary: The universal command bar, opened with ⌘/Ctrl+K, that reaches every action and destination.

components.name: HintOverlay
components.summary: A Vimium-style overlay: press F and every clickable thing gets a letter.

components.name: Island
components.summary: Dynamic-island toasts that expand from the top centre, hold briefly, and fold away.

components.name: Orb
components.summary: A slow breathing gradient orb for loading and thinking states.

components.name: Progress
components.summary: Gradient progress bars and rings for waits where you know how far along you are.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: An illustrated empty state with a dry headline, a line of wit and one action.

components.name: Bloom
components.summary: Dialogs, menus and popovers that grow out of the element that opened them and shrink back on close.

components.name: Rows
components.summary: Floating list rows with a checkbox, title, meta line and optional gems.

components.name: LiftShuffle
components.summary: Drag-to-reorder for rows: grab by the grip, neighbours shuffle aside, release to settle; Alt+arrows for keyboard.

components.name: Lasso
components.summary: Drag a soft rectangle around rows to select them; a bulk bar rises with Archive, Move and hold-to-delete.

components.name: Chart
components.summary: Glow-line charts with a hover crosshair, legend, keyboard traversal and a table view.

components.name: Transitions
components.summary: View transitions: a morph for drill-ins and a depth push for peer views.

components.name: SunTheme
components.summary: Follow-the-sun theming: dawn, noon, dusk and night, switching by the local hour.

components.name: Sensory
components.summary: Short synthesised sounds and haptic ticks with a single master mute.

components.name: Delight
components.summary: The finishing touches: time-aware greetings, celebrations, and idle antics.

components.name: Layout
components.summary: The bento layout: a 12-column grid of glass tiles with a rail on the left.

components.name: Icons
components.summary: The hairline icon set: 1.25px stroke, round caps, 24px grid, always currentColor.
